content.title: Wurth M8x30-8.8 Hex Bolt, M8 x 1.25 Thread, 30mm Length, Zinc Plated, Class 8.8, ISO 898-1
content.short_description: Wurth M8x30-8.8 hex bolt, carbon steel, zinc plated finish, property class 8.8 per ISO 898-1. M8 x 1.25 thread, 30mm length.
content.long_description:
The Wurth M8x30-8.8 is a hex head bolt manufactured from carbon steel with a zinc plated finish for corrosion resistance. The bolt features an M8 thread with a 1.25mm pitch and an overall length of 30mm, driven with a standard hex drive.

This fastener is rated to property class 8.8 under ISO 898-1, with a tensile strength of 800 MPa. Property class 8.8 bolts are commonly specified in structural, machinery, and automotive assembly applications requiring defined mechanical performance under load.

Material: carbon steel. Finish: zinc plated. Standard: ISO 898-1. Confirm thread engagement length and mating nut/tapped hole specifications (M8 x 1.25) before installation.
